commands.mobrealms.summary: Camps: %s | Citizens: %s | Simulated days: %s | Queued days: %s
commands.mobrealms.no_relations: At least two camps are needed to show relations.
commands.mobrealms.queued: Queued %s abstract days. Loaded residents remain physically simulated.
commands.mobrealms.busy: No days queued: simulation halted or the 365-day queue is full.
commands.mobrealms.founded: Camp founded with starter shelter and residents.
commands.mobrealms.site_blocked: Cannot found here: use clear, flat 3×3 ground with four blocks of headroom, inside one unprotected chunk, 48 blocks from other camps. Check population limits.
commands.mobrealms.protected: Chunk %s, %s protected against Mob Realms gathering and founding.
commands.mobrealms.halted: Simulation halted after a save error. Check the server log before restarting.
commands.mobrealms.cancelled: Cancelled %s pending days. Completed deliveries are preserved.
gui.mobrealms.title: Mob Realms – Administration
gui.mobrealms.limitations: Daily logic and founding attempts; does not fast-forward vanilla. City growth is not implemented yet. Use Refresh to update this snapshot.
commands.mobrealms.speed_scope: Time-lapse affects the entire server. 1× = 20 TPS; actual speed depends on performance. Reset with /civ speed 1.
commands.mobrealms.observe: Observer mode: fly freely or click a mob to follow it. Sneak exits its camera; /civ observe creative or survival exits spectator mode.
